faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT ISM Dhanbad JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT ISM Dhanbad is 17th August 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M. Tech./M.E./MS in Electronics or related fields, or a B. Tech./B.E. degree, or an M.Sc in Electronics or Physics (with Electronics/Photonics specialization). GATE/NET qualification is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post is 35 years. Age relaxations are applicable for SC/ST, OBC (Non-creamy layer), and PH candidates as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Research Fellow is Rs. 37,000/- per month for the first and second year, and Rs. 42,000/- per month for the third year.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIT ISM Dhanbad JRF position?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the provided application link. Ensure all required documents are attached and the form is filled accurately before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the official notification, no application fee is mentioned for this recruitment drive. Candidates can proceed with their application without any fee payment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their merit and the project's requirements, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: This is a project-based research position at IIT ISM Dhanbad.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is TTDF/6G/162.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT ISM Dhanbad located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines), Dhanbad is located in Dhanbad, Jharkhand, with the pincode 826004.
